description: This file defines geometric utility macros, function prototypes, and includes for geometric computations related to vertices and edges, likely used in tessellation or mesh processing within the 'libtess2' library.

methods.name: tesvertLeq
methods.description: Compares two vertices for less than or equal based on their s and t coordinates.

methods.name: tesedgeEval
methods.description: Evaluates the edge function for three vertices.

methods.name: tesedgeSign
methods.description: Computes the sign of the edge function for three vertices.

methods.name: testransSign
methods.description: Transposed version of edge sign calculation.

methods.name: tesvertCCW
methods.description: Determines if three vertices are counter-clockwise.

methods.name: tesedgeIntersect
methods.description: Calculates the intersection point of two edges.
